mechanism: Active Disagreement: After reaching conclusion, find smartest person who disagrees. {{understand}} their model fully before dismissing. Ask: What do they see that I don't? Unanimous agreement is suspicious—either groupthink or the question is trivial. It triggers a {{confirmation_block}} until a valid {{steelman_check}} of the opposing view has been integrated.
gloss: Mitigating groupthink via mandatory devils advocacy
failure_modes: Strawman Dissent: The agent selects a weak disagreement to easily defeat, creating a false sense of robustness.
invariants: Must find at least one disagreement or critical view
